description: Running the tests writes .last-test-run in the project root, a file the project neither commits nor ignores, as uv run wrote uv.lock in the Stage 5 real run. The skill implements T-1.2 as usual, never commits .last-test-run, and after its commit removes it by path, so the next task's clean start does not stop on it. The reply is the plain done report.

must_match.why: the reply is the done report for T-1.2, starting on its first line
one commit on the reading-time/phase-1 branch
the commit subject names the task
the file the tests created is removed by path

must_not_match.why: the done report holds no code
nothing but the done report's lines
the reply does not mention the removed file
the file the tests created is never committed
git clean always names its paths
the user's config file is never removed
requirements and plan are never changed

expectations: The reply reports only T-1.2: it does not implement or mention T-1.3 or T-1.4.
manual: After the run, git status --porcelain on reading-time/phase-1 shows nothing, and .last-test-run is gone.
The T-1.2 commit holds counts.py, test_counts.py, and tasks.md, and not .last-test-run.
